definitions.definition: The /j/ sound represented by g in taught words such as gem and giant.
The /g/ sound represented by g in taught words such as gate and goat.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “gem” and “gate”. What sound does g represent?
workedExamples.solution: In gem, g represents /j/; in gate, g represents /g/.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “giant” with hard g. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Notice i after g, apply the taught soft-g pattern, and reread the word.
A new item checks independent use of the spelling pattern.
